label: Delete my recordings after (days)
globalLimit: Your organisation deletes recordings after at most {{days}} days. You can choose a shorter period for your own recordings.
noGlobalLimit: Your organisation has not set a deletion period. You can choose one for your own recordings.
invalid: Please enter a whole number between 1 and {{max}}.
hint: Leave empty to use only your organisation's period. Deleted recordings, audio included, cannot be recovered.
